phases.name: single-agent instrumentation
phases.summary: Successfully built the single-agent instrumentation layer containing the `instrument_llm_call` wrapper, mapping core GenAI metadata (model name, input/output token counts, latency) according to OTel GenAI Semantic Conventions v1.27.0. Set up a local Jaeger instance as our OTel collector and backend on Windows, and verified that a simulated agent running these calls produces correct, visible traces in the backend.

tasks.description: Build instrument_llm_call(model, messages, **kwargs) wrapper emitting OTel spans with gen_ai.* attributes
Set up a local OTel Collector config and a backend (e.g. OpenObserve or Tempo)
Instrument simulated developer agent making LLM calls and verify traces

phases.name: tool calls + multi-agent hierarchy
phases.summary: Designed and implemented child span propagation via `instrument_tool_call` and nested/parallel agent trees using `dispatch_subagent`. Verified propagation by simulating a full hierarchical orchestration loop: a Lead agent dispatches a Developer subagent (creating a nested span tree), followed by parallel dispatches of Security and QA subagents (creating concurrent sibling branches under a shared 'Review Cycle' parent). The final 10-span trace tree was successfully verified in the backend.

tasks.description: Build dispatch_subagent helper for nested agent dispatches
Simulate parallel dispatch of Security and QA under a shared parent and verify trace tree

phases.name: cost aggregation
phases.summary: Created `aggregate_cost(trace_id)` logic inside `agentscope/cost.py` to traverse trace span trees, resolve model names, and compute total token counts and USD costs using a configurable model pricing table. Exposed this via a queryable endpoint running in a background service on port 8000. Verified that querying the endpoint with a test trace ID returned totals (700 tokens, 3 calls, $0.01462 USD) that matched our hand-calculated results exactly.

tasks.description: Create aggregate_cost(trace_id) to traverse trace and roll up tokens/costs
Build queryable cost endpoint on port 8000 using HTTP server
Ensure cost aggregation matches manual hand-calculation from raw span data

phases.name: approval-gate integration
phases.summary: Created a ledger helper module `agentscope/ledger.py` that parses the task ledger format and supports automatic trace ID binding for task executions. Integrated a simple lookup function that maps a ledger task entry to a direct, clickable Jaeger UI trace link (e.g. `http://localhost:16686/trace/<trace_id>`). Verified that resolving a sample ledger entry successfully returns the direct link without requiring manual trace ID copy-pasting.

tasks.description: Add automatic trace_id field population into ledger task entries
Build lookup returning direct Jaeger UI link given task entry keys
